product_metadata.title: Melitta Basket Coffee Filters, Natural Brown, 100 Count
features: Melitta cone filters micro fine perforations allow coffee's full flavor to filter through as it traps bitter grounds and sediments.
Melitta cone filters are made with only oxygen cleansed paper and designed with a 2nd safety crimp for strength and durability, guartanteed not to burst.
Melitta makes an annual donation to fund the replenishment of trees across the United States.
description: Fits most 8-12 cup coffeemakers. Textured, thicker paper. Traps more oils. Made in USA.
